Claude Code guidance for this modern, cross-platform dotfiles repository (macOS, Linux, WSL), with tiered shell, tmux, and Neovim configurations.

Install:
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link

CLI:
dot setup              # Idempotent environment setup
dot check              # Comprehensive health validation
dot update             # Update all components
dot reload             # Reload shell configuration
dot project init       # Create new project
dot ai review          # AI code review
dot security scan      # Security audit
dot metrics dashboard  # View system metrics
dot plugin list        # Manage plugins
dot migrate status     # Check for updates
dot test quick
dot test run                 # Run all tests
dot test <component>
dot plugin install <plugin-name>
dot doctor                   # Diagnose issues
perf-status                  # Check performance
perf-bench                   # Run benchmarks
perf-quick                   # One-command optimization

Tests and lint:
./tests/test_runner.sh
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint

Always run the full test suite: `./tests/test_runner.sh`
Test specific components: `dot test <component>`
Validate linting: shellcheck and yamllint
Check cross-platform compatibility.

Structure: `bin/` (CLI/utilities), `config/` (templates/core configs), `lib/` (libraries), `plugins/` (modular plugins), `scripts/` (installer/utilities), `tests/` (testing framework). Main interface: `bin/dot`; modular CLI libraries in `lib/cli/`: `core.sh` (setup/check/update), `ai.sh`, `security.sh`, `project.sh`, `testing.sh`.

Tools are declarative in `config/tools.yaml`; profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Automatic platform/package-manager detection. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`; template: `plugins/local/hello-world/`. Neovim tiers: Tier 1: 8 essential plugins; Tier 2: 23; Tier 3: 33+.
Neovim: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`.
Tmux: `config/tmux/tmux.conf`, `config/tmux/core.conf`; Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, | and - splits.
Zsh: `config/zsh/`; performance modes fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms); resource auto-detection, autosuggestions, history management. Streamlined from 66 to 10 essential keybindings with tier system.

Adding a tool: edit `config/tools.yaml`, add to es
